1 (Currently amended): A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the method is performed using a computing device configured to execute the steps.

19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user using a user device.

23 (Currently amended): The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of the user, wherein the role of the user is defined by the second unique identifier.

24 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for the user, wherein the user is identified by the unique identifier.
